purpose: Scientific adjudication of the five tests in tests/test_phase2_south_coast_ica_arequipa_discovery.py that fail under real pytest but were never executed by the legacy 'unittest discover' CI. For each one: whether the expectation or the inventory state was wrong, the evidence used, and exactly what was changed. No control is relaxed and nothing becomes publishable or operational.

scope.root_cause: The test module was last edited in 30d25ce1 (2026-09-26). Later package commits (e9278551 completeness addendum; Quitasol/Paracas critical-point registration) changed the inventory, and the legacy CI could not notice because unittest discovery silently skips pytest-style functions.

live_official_reference.institution: Autoridad Nacional del Agua via IDEP (Infraestructura de Datos Espaciales del Perú)
live_official_reference.retrieval_method: Attribute-only query read through a text-extracting fetcher; response bytes were not captured.
live_official_reference.use: Corroboration of CODIGO/NOMBRE identity only. Not geometry, not hazard, not event, not threshold evidence.

evidence: Inventory rows arequipa_choclon (137152) and arequipa_honda (137158) were added by e9278551 together with official_parent_additions in the hydrographic-completeness addendum, citing ANA-AAA-SOUTH-UH-2009 and ANA-RJ-056-2018-SOUTH-COURSES.
Live ANA/IDEP layer returns '137152 Cuenca Choclón' and '137158 Cuenca Honda', and every other parent code of the inventory with the expected name.
findings.change: EXPECTED_BASINS gains the two ids. Added guards: unique codes, summary count derived from inventory, non-publishable/BLOCKED/null thresholds per parent, and a provenance test tying both parents to the addendum, its official sources, the course context and the Honda homonym guard.
findings.limitations: The two ANA PDFs cited by the addendum are not archived (content_sha256 null, unchanged) and www.ana.gob.pe was not reachable from this environment; the live corroboration is not byte-frozen.

evidence: The same module already requires ica_quitasol and ica_paracas in this system (test_ica_pisco_quitasol_and_paracas_are_parent_bound_but_not_events), so 'children == []' was an internal contradiction left from the earlier revision.

Identity: each child has a single source, ANA-ICA-CRITICAL-POINTS-DU015-2023 (Anexo II, critical points for cleaning and desilting), whose recorded support is 'Qda. Quitasol — Cuenca Pisco' and 'Qda. Paracas — Cuenca Pisco'. Parent binding: Cuenca Pisco UH 13752, confirmed as an official unit in the live ANA/IDEP layer.
Evidence nature: CRITICAL_POINT_CONTEXT_NOT_EVENT; geometry_asset and outlet null; probes PLANNED_FAIL_CLOSED_NOT_EXECUTED; not publishable; BLOCKED.

A separate INDECI record (Informe de Emergencia 472, 2019-02-10, Huancano) names Quebrada Quitasol jointly with Huayanto and Remanso. It lives in config/phase2_ica_2019_named_events_v0_1.json with parent assignment pending and is not attached to the child.
findings.change: The assertion now pins the exact child set and proves what the test is about: the Huancano 2026 event stays unnamed, shares no source with either child, and no child is a 'Grande'. A new test keeps four things apart for both children: ravine identity, critical point, historical event and geometry.
findings.limitations: The ANA Anexo II PDF could not be re-read in this session (robots/timeout) and is not archived; the name-to-basin binding rests on the provenance recorded on 2026-09-26. Quitasol has independent official corroboration of its name (INDECI 2019); Paracas has none beyond the ANA list.

evidence: Canonical do_not_infer: "Lucha is a territorial locality in this source. Do not create or name a child 'Quebrada Lucha' without independent hydrologic evidence." The prohibition is a second sentence and correctly starts with a capital letter; the test searched the lowercase form. Letter case only.
No child id or name contains 'lucha'; the event has named_child null and status TERRITORIAL_EVENT_PENDING_LOCAL_GEOMETRY.
findings.change: Canonical wording left untouched. The test pins the full sentence exactly, keeps the original phrase as a case-insensitive check, and additionally requires the pending status and no child binding.

evidence: Seven territorial events exist. Six name no ravine and carry TERRITORIAL_EVENT_PENDING_LOCAL_GEOMETRY (Ocucaje 2026, Huancano 2026, Vítor 2026, Lucha 2025, Secocha 2023, Chala San Andrés II 2025). None shares a source with any child.

The seventh, ica_yauca_rosario_2024_03_16, is not unnamed: its COEN-INDECI source names Quebrada San José de Curis and Quebrada San Isidro de Macchanga, both registered children citing that same source. NAMED_CHILDREN_CONFIRMED_TOPOLOGY_PARTIAL is the correct status; PENDING_LOCAL_GEOMETRY would erase a directly sourced attribution.
The mismatch came from the singular field: named_child was null because two ravines are named, and the test read null as 'no ravine identified'.
findings.change: State: additive field named_children on that one event listing the two existing child ids. No status, evidence state, source or hash was altered. Test: 'unnamed' now means no named_child and no named_children, and must be PENDING; the named status is only accepted with an explicit binding to same-system children backed by the event's own source; for every system, no child has geometry, outlet, publication or activation. Two regressions added.
findings.limitations: The INDECI report is not archived (content_sha256 null, unchanged) and was not re-read in this session.

evidence: official_intercuenca_contexts holds 14 rows with 14 distinct codes; summary says 14; the completeness addendum requires 14 and lists the same codes; its dedicated test already enforces this.
All 14 codes appear in the live ANA/IDEP layer as 'Intercuenca <code>'. The literal 1 predates the addendum.
findings.change: The expectation is derived from the inventory (len == summary == 14) and a dedicated test pins codes, addendum equality, source support, disjointness from parent codes and fail-closed fields. new_operational_zones == 0 untouched.
findings.limitations: Same non-archived ANA sources as F1.

open_scientific_items.statement: The live ANA layer also lists Intercuenca 137539, adjacent to Cuenca Topará (137534) on the Ica/Lima boundary. It is not in the inventory nor in the addendum's 14. Whether it belongs to the Ica scope is undecided; it was deliberately not added here.

ANA Anexo II DU 015-2023, ANA AAA delimitation memoir, RJ 056-2018-ANA and the INDECI reports remain not archived. Until bytes and hashes are frozen, identity claims depend on recorded text retrieval.

Parent binding to Cuenca Grande 1372 withdrawn on 2026-10-03 (see parent_binding_adjudication). Open: execute the ANA SNIRH named-channel probe for both ravines from an environment that can reach geosnirh.ana.gob.pe, archive the bytes, and read CODIGO_UH from the result.

Found while hardening the homonym regression: ica_cansas cites INDECI-CANSAS-HISTORICAL-PLAN, and ica_la_yesera and ica_tortolita cite ANA-CENEPRED-ICA-VULNERABLE-MAPS, but neither id has a source_catalog entry. The citations were left untouched; the sources need to be catalogued with URL and provenance. Uncatalogued ids never count as parent-binding evidence.

Only Quebrada Cansas has an explicit statement of membership in a parent UH (ANA-CANSAS-UH1374-2025, itself pending archive). No other child of any system has an explicit parent-binding statement; their parents are asserted at system level and are not exposed to a homonymous receiver, so the detector does not flag them. They remain to be reproduced by the planned ANA named-channel probes.

parent_binding_adjudication.question: Do Quebrada San José de Curis and Quebrada San Isidro de Macchanga belong to ANA Cuenca Grande UH 1372?

official_evidence_attempted.detail: Connection timeout from this environment (both the fetcher and the shell). This is the only registered official layer carrying ravine names with CODIGO_UH. Unreachable is not a negative result.

Layers exposed: Humedales Costeros, Manantial, Glaciares, Hidrometeorológica, AAA, Unidades Hidrográficas (7, 8), Consejo de Recursos Hídricos, ALA, Marino Costero. No river or ravine layer, so ravine identity cannot be matched here.

official_evidence_attempted.source: ANA via IDEP, layer 7 Unidades Hidrográficas
official_evidence_attempted.detail: OBJECTID_1 164, CODIGO 1372, NOMBRE 'Cuenca Grande', AREA_KM2 10991.2703; OBJECTID_1 163, CODIGO 1374, NOMBRE 'Cuenca Ica', AREA_KM2 7301.8761. Confirms the two units exist; says nothing about the ravines.

«...un huaico que incrementó el caudal de las quebradas de San José de Curis y San Isidro de Macchanga el mismo que discurre por los ríos Chico y Río Grande en el sector Pampahuasi y centro poblado de Orongocucho, que causó daños a la captación de agua para consumo humano en el distrito de Yauca del Rosario, provincia de Ica.» Confirms ravine names, receiver names and localities. Names no hydrographic unit.

why_not_demonstrated: No official hydrographic record tying either ravine to a UH code could be obtained.
The previous binding rested only on the receiver name 'Río Grande', which the package's own rule same_name_receiver_must_not_be_conflated_with_official_basin forbids as a basis.
Responses were read through a text-extracting fetcher; no bytes could be frozen from this environment, so even unit-level corroboration is not byte-reproducible.

contextual_observation_not_evidence.use: NOT_EVIDENCE_FOR_ASSIGNMENT. Recorded only because it contradicts the withdrawn binding and shows why a candidate must not be inferred either.
contextual_observation_not_evidence.observation: Point-in-polygon queries on IDEP layer 7 with non-official approximate coordinates for the locality Pampahuasi and for the district reference point of Yauca del Rosario both returned CODIGO 1374 'Cuenca Ica', not 1372.
why_not_usable: Coordinates come from non-official web sources and are not stored in this package (no approximate points).
A locality or district point is not a ravine; the probe contract forbids fallback by proximity or district name.
contextual_observation_not_evidence.consequence: The system is not transferred to Cuenca Ica. candidate_parent_basin_ids stays empty until the official named-channel probe is executed.

regression_hardening.reason: The first detector exempted a system whenever any child cited a source from the hydrographic authority. An ANA source can be a marginal strip, a works package, a critical-point list or a nominal identity, none of which states that a ravine belongs to a given parent UH.
regression_hardening.rule: A homonym-exposed system is exempt only if one of its children cites a source carrying a parent_binding_assertions entry that names that child (id and name), the system's parent_basin_id and that basin's official_unit_code, with relation CHANNEL_BELONGS_TO_PARENT_UH and a statement present verbatim in the source's supports that contains both the UH code and the ravine's proper name. The institution is not a criterion.
regression_hardening.state_change: Additive field parent_binding_assertions on ANA-CANSAS-UH1374-2025, structuring its existing supports statement. No status, evidence state, hash or provenance changed.
